Indicator 1.1 One project in pipeline to enhance Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC) implementation. In partnership with SCALA and Climate promise projects, SIDA is collaborating to develop bankable projects to enhance NDC implementation, so far 5 draft concept notes are being reviewed together with MWR
Indicator 1.2 -Zero strategies developed to increase women’s access to well-paid employment in the energy sector and biodiversity. Specific women’s empowerment projects and those aiming to get them well paid jobs are limited within the unit and absent in this project. However, the development of gender action plans and support to specific gender activities in some few projects with the NCE unit is enhancing gender empowerment. Also the disbursement of grants to women and youth led community groups through the unit projects including CSA and NDC greatly contributed to women’s empowerment in the form of trainings, leadership and income and livelihoods enhancement.
Indicator 1.3 -149(92 male, 57 female) beneficiaries trained on sessions related to integrated programming -54(33 male, 21 female) partners and staff trained on Social and Environmental Safeguards (SES) -59(32 male, 27 female) trained on gender, environment, climate, and energy nexus. -36(27 male, 9 female) enforcement team partners trained on effective ecosystems management
Indicator 1.4 Completed and reported in 2021 ROAR. Staff and partners trained on geder and gender maker and gender rating training for staff and partners planed for Q1 next year. Indicator 1.5 -Zero, solution platforms will likely be developed only after activities but in other projects as these SIDA activities can’t support this indicator.
Indicator 2.1 One, capacity assessment of UNDP and implementing partner staff of Nature Climate Energy and Resilience (NCER) portfolio was carried out. The assessment included the organizational, institutional, and technical capacities assessment and a capacity building plan was developed.
Indicator 2.2 Yes, financing and implementation plan in place. This was developed in collaboration with other NCR unit projects including NDC, Climate Promise and SCALA
Indicator 3.1 One Public Private Partnership (PPP) supported. Supporting ongoing government process of developing an integrated energy resource master plan and also participated in government organized energy and minerals week and supported energy efficiency and electric mobility conference. Discussions are also ongoing for the project to a private public sector dialogue to increase investment in renewable energy initiatives
A National Renewable Energy Platform is in place with 5 thematic working groups.
Indicator 3.2 Zero. SIDA project funding is limited to undertake such actions. However, through the NDC support programme, solar PV installations have been completed in 11 health centers across the country that is supporting lifesaving operations of health units in the rural settings. SIDA funds will also be used to support the government in developing a renewable energy master plan. Also supported two youths to participate in sustainable energy for all (SE4all) conference in Rwanda where they participated in the youth dialogue and business clinics on promoting renewable energy access. Indicator 3.3 -Zero Carried out capacity assessment of NCER staff and implementing partners to assess the organizational, institutional, and technical capacities and developed a capacity building plan. Supported a workshop to discuss and refine the scope of the long-term integrated energy resource master plan master plan and develop a roadmap. A total of 38 (24 male, 14 female) participants attended. A National Renewable Energy Platform is in place with 5 thematic working groups.
Indicator 4.1 -Two (2) actions supported- National food systems stakeholders retreat and currently supporting the food systems strategic analysis Indicator 4.2 -Supported the national food systems retreat for stakeholder in which 62 participants (45 male 17 female) attended the workshop -The support was provided to the Office of the Prime Minister to facilitate national food systems retreat to review documents (ToRs for a national food system coordinating committee, strategic food systems analysis) and initiated development of a road map for food systems transformation. Have also pledge financial support to carry out food systems strategic analysis to feed in the development of the food systems transformation road map
